I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes:

1. **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025 because the gatehouse kiosk at the Eau Claire yard wasn't texting drivers their bay assignments (Dock Doors 14–18, 04:00 shift). Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed it was fixed on 5 Oct. The note also says to archive the kiosk logs before the 14 Oct 2025 maintenance window.
2. **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 support to test the scanner firmware. The note is undated, so I can't tell when this happened or whether it's still open.

Some things to leave out of the weekly notes:
- **#4409 and #4412** in the Central handoffs note are for Marrow Fieldworks, Pree's dealer account, not QFL.
- **FR-882** is a feature request from Marrow Agrisupply.
- The cheat sheet mentions Quarendon Freightways, a different company that isn't a Pemberline customer. Don't mix it up with QFL.

Moss's other two North notes (9/14 pipeline, 3/23 renewal) mention QFL but don't give any ticket numbers. I only checked Moss's six public digests, so there may be more QFL tickets in the CRM or ticket system that Moss never wrote down.
